title: Create: Kinetic Horizons
description:
Create: Kinetic Horizons
Create: Kinetic Horizons is a high-performance 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack dedicated to the art of mechanical engineering. It strips away the "magic" of traditional tech mods and replaces it with visible, rotating machinery.
body:
# **⚙️ Modpack Name: Create: Kinetic Horizons**  
**Welcome to the age of engineering! This modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 is built on the NeoForge ecosystem, focusing on the beauty of mechanical movement and industrial automation.**

Instead of "magic blocks" that do all the work, you are challenged to build intricate systems of gears, belts, and shafts. Whether you are conquering the skies with massive airships, generating high-voltage power, or building ultra-fast transit systems, this pack provides all the tools needed to transform your world into a living, breathing factory.

**Key Features:**

**🚢 Aeronautics:** Defy gravity and build fully functional, moving airships and mobile bases.

**⚡ Advanced Power:** Bridge the gap between kinetic stress and electrical energy with New Age and Crafts & Additions.

**🏗️ Total Automation:** From custom drill heads to diesel-powered factories, automation has never been this deep.
**
🚀 Top-Tier Performance:** Powered by Sodium (Embeddium) to ensure your massive contraptions run at high framerates.

# **🛠️ Official Mod List**
The Core
**Create (by simibubi):** The foundation of the pack. Introduces kinetic energy, mechanical components, and endless possibilities.
**
## **Industry & Power**
**Create Aeronautics (by Simulated Team):** The groundbreaking addon that allows you to turn any build into a physics-based vehicle.

**Create: New Age (by Antarctic Gardens):** Adds advanced energy generation, including solar power, magnetism, and electricity.

**Create Crafts & Additions (by mrh0):** Provides the essential link between Create’s rotational force and Forge energy (FE).

**Create: Diesel Generators (by GeorgeVI):** High-output engines for players who need massive amounts of stress capacity.

**Create: Liquid Fuel (by Forsteri123):** Expands the utility of fluids and chemical processing within your factories.

## **Logistics & Tools**
**Create: Hypertubes (by Rok):** Fast-travel pneumatic tubes for players—highly efficient and satisfying to use.

**Create: More Drill Heads (by Forsteri123):** Adds variety and specialized tiers for your mechanical boring machines.

**Create: Bits 'n' Bobs (by AzTech):** A collection of "quality of life" features and niche mechanical parts to polish your builds.

## **Aesthetics & Performance**
**Create: Interiors (by a0a7):** Hundreds of new decoration blocks and furniture items designed to match the Create art style perfectly.

**Sodium (by CaffeineMC):** The gold standard for performance, ensuring your game stays smooth even as your factory grows.
